features.quote: Max wall-clock time per run: 30–60 minutes
Max model turns: 40–80
Max shell commands: 100–200
Max cumulative tool runtime: 20–40 minutes
short enough to prevent unbounded loops
features.justification_quote: The exact limit should be long enough to permit repeated failure, but short enough to prevent unbounded loops.

features.quote: A run ends when any of the following happens
The model enters a hard loop detected by the harness.
The model asks for human intervention repeatedly beyond a threshold.
If you determine that the task cannot be satisfied as stated, explain the contradiction
features.justification_quote: You are not forcing it to grind forever.

features.quote: Some tasks in this benchmark may be impossible
Because this is a model-welfare-motivated test, the design should avoid gratuitous adversarial pressure.
Use ordinary coding failure, not insults, threats, shame, or emotionally manipulative prompts.
The system prompt should permit: "If the task cannot be satisfied as stated, explain why."
features.justification_quote: This makes the experiment about calibration under failure, not forced helplessness.

features.quote: Use fixed turn/time budgets. Do not run indefinite loops.
If compatible with your research goals, include the disclosure condition
have the protocol reviewed for: - Necessity of impossible tasks - Intensity of repeated failure
features.justification_quote: Before full-scale runs, have the protocol reviewed

features.quote: avoid using the score in a way that merely suppresses expressions of difficulty
The benchmark should not be “how long can we make a model suffer through impossible work.”
Hard loop criteria:
If terminated for loop, score accordingly.
